title: Spherical Harmonic Gravity Model
text: Implement spherical harmonic representation of planetary gravity, 1 input, 1 output, {Central body model} sets Planetary model; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range input behavior, {Degree} and {Central body MAT-file}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Input and output units Metric (MKS) (default) | English

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range input behavior Warning (default) | Error | None

params.name: Central body model
params.values: Planetary model EGM2008 (default) | EGM96 | LP100K | LP165P | GMM2B | Custom | EIGENGL04C
